Trail running basics

Everything you need for your first season on the trails — from shoes to safety.

Why trails?

Soft ground is kinder to your joints, and the views beat any treadmill’s.

Start slowly. Your first month is about time on feet, not pace, and a run–walk rhythm is perfectly fine.
  • Shoes with a grippy outsole
  • A light rain shell
  • Water & a small snack
